title: 教育心理学（夏期集中講義）
subtitle: Educational Psychology
educationalGoal: The aim of this course is to understand the basic knowledge of educational psychology which is necessary for effective educational practice in high school. In particular, we will learn about development, learning, adjustment, and educational evaluation. As a specific topic, students will consider each developmental stage until adolescence, and support for developmental disorder.
advice:
This course covers knowledge of educational psychology which is necessary for effective educational practice in high school.
  1. Development: 1)definition of development, 2) principles and characteristics of development, 3)developmental theories, 4)infancy and early childhood, 5)school age, 6) adolescence
  2. Maladjustment
  3. Learning: 1)definition of learning, 2)learning theories, 3) application of learning theories to education
  4. Motivation
  5. Educational evaluation
  6. Developmental disorder: 1)basic knowledge of developmental disorder, 2)support for students with developmental disorder
books: Junichi Nishimura & Sumie Nishimura(eds.) (2010) Essentials of Educational Psychology(2nd ed.). Nakanishiya Shuppan.
requiredKnowledge:
●To be interested in psychology, or to have taken “Introduction to Teacher Certification Course”.
●Aim to obtain a Japanese teacher's license.

activityGoals.body: Be able to understand the significance of development, explain it in text.
Be able to answer the question about the basics of educational psychology.
Be able to explain the feature of adolescence and psychological maladjustment in text.
Be able to state an opinion on the support for students with developmental disorder.
Be able to engage in this course and self-evaluate objectives of this course to be achieved.

achievementLevels.ideal:
1) Understand the basics of educational psychology in relation to practice by teachers.

2) Understand the features of adolescence and maladjustment, and apply them to actual examples.

3) Understand developmental disorder with counseling mind, and how to support the students with developmental disorder.
achievementLevels.standard:
1) Understand the basics of educational psychology.

2) Understand the features of adolescence and maladjustment.

3) Understand how to support the students with developmental disorder.

              The aim of this course is to understand the basic knowledge of educational psychology which is necessary for effective educational practice in high school. In particular, we will learn about development, learning, adjustment, and educational evaluation. As a specific topic, students will consider each developmental stage until adolescence, and support for developmental disorder.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              This course covers knowledge of educational psychology which is necessary for effective educational practice in high school.
  1. Development: 1)definition of development, 2) principles and characteristics of development, 3)developmental theories, 4)infancy and early childhood, 5)school age, 6) adolescence
  2. Maladjustment
  3. Learning: 1)definition of learning, 2)learning theories, 3) application of learning theories to education
  4. Motivation
  5. Educational evaluation
  6. Developmental disorder: 1)basic knowledge of developmental disorder, 2)support for students with developmental disorder

              教科書および参考書・リザーブドブック

              Junichi Nishimura & Sumie Nishimura(eds.) (2010) Essentials of Educational Psychology(2nd ed.). Nakanishiya Shuppan.
